text:
The plate looks like a side plate of about 22 cm. The food on it is 5 dark olives (probably Kalamata) and a small pile of chicken salad.

The olives are about 3 cm long, so each weighs roughly 6-8 g with the pit. Five olives come to about 35 g, or about 50 kcal.

The chicken salad is a small clump of about 5 x 4 cm plus a smaller piece. I estimate it at 70-80 g. At about 190 kcal per 100 g for a mayonnaise-based chicken salad, that is roughly 140 kcal.

Together that is about 110 g of food and about 190 kcal.
